list.title: Artworks
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No artworks} one {One artwork} other {# artworks}}

new.title: New artwork
new.intro: Start with the basics. Photos, price and shipping are added in the editor.
new.slugHint: Lower-case Latin letters and hyphens, e.g. sunset-jaffa. Empty = derived from the English title. Cannot change after the first publish.

editor.created: The artwork was created. Now add photos and details.
editor.deleteDraftConfirm: Delete the draft and its photos? This cannot be undone.
editor.liveHold: A buyer is checking out right now (order {order}) until {time}.
editor.liveHoldInFlight: A payment for this work (order {order}) is being confirmed. The sale status cannot change until it finishes.
editor.lapsedHold: The hold of order {order} lapsed at {time}; it will be released automatically.

fields.slugLocked: The slug is locked since the first publish.
fields.mediumDetailHint: For example "Oil on canvas". Shown on the artwork card.
fields.featured: Featured work (shown on the home page)
fields.priceIls: Price in ILS (incl. VAT if applicable)
fields.priceUsdHint: Needed to sell abroad. Empty = sold in Israel only.
fields.confirmPriceChangeHint: Price changes are recorded in the audit log. Open orders keep the price they locked.
fields.canBeRolled: The canvas can be rolled for a tube
fields.customsDescriptionHint: For example "Original oil painting on canvas, signed by the artist".
fields.altHint: A short description of what is visible, for screen readers. Required before publishing.

photos.intro: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 30 MB. The first photo becomes the main image.
photos.deleteConfirm: Delete the photo? This cannot be undone.

checklist.title: Publish checklist
checklist.altTexts: Hebrew and English alt text on every photo
checklist.unpublishConfirm: Remove the artwork from the site? It will not appear in the gallery until published again.
checklist.isPublished: The artwork is published on the site.
checklist.isDraft: The artwork is not published yet.

shipping.defaults: Packing data is missing; the calculation uses defaults.

sale.holdIntro: The artwork shows as "On hold" and cannot be bought on the site.
sale.releaseDone: The hold was released. The artwork is available.
sale.soldIntro: Record a sale made in the studio, at an exhibition or by transfer. The artwork will show as sold.
sale.soldConfirm: Record the artwork as sold? It will show as sold on the site.
sale.notForSaleIntro: The artwork stays in the gallery without a buy option.
sale.notForSaleDone: The artwork is marked not for sale.
sale.forSaleDone: The artwork is available for sale.
sale.relistIntro: Voids the sale and makes the artwork available. For a sale on the site: only after the order is cancelled, the refund has settled and the returned work was inspected.
sale.relistConfirm: Void the sale and make the artwork available again?
sale.damagedConfirm: Void the sale and mark the artwork not for sale?
sale.damagedDone: The artwork is marked not for sale.
sale.overrideMessage: A buyer is checking out until {time} (order {order}). Confirming cancels their order and releases the hold. If they pay anyway, the money is refunded automatically.

errors.SLUG_TAKEN: Another artwork already uses this slug.
errors.SLUG_REQUIRED: Please enter a slug in Latin letters.
errors.SLUG_LOCKED: The slug cannot change after the first publish.
errors.PRICE_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: The price changed. Tick the confirmation box and save again.
errors.PUBLISH_CHECKLIST: The publish checklist is not complete.
errors.LIVE_HOLD: A buyer is checking out right now. Reload the page and confirm the cancellation.
errors.PAYMENT_IN_FLIGHT: A payment for this artwork is being confirmed. Please try again once it finishes.
errors.HOLD_CHANGED: The hold changed in the meantime. Please reload and try again.
errors.NOT_ON_HOLD: The artwork is not on hold.
errors.NOT_SELLABLE: A sale cannot be recorded in the current state.
errors.ALREADY_SOLD: The artwork already has a recorded sale.
errors.NOT_SOLD: The artwork is not marked as sold.
errors.ORDER_NOT_CANCELLED: The order has not been cancelled yet.
errors.REFUND_NOT_SETTLED: The refund has not settled yet.
errors.RETURN_PENDING: The artwork has not been returned and inspected yet.
errors.MAIN_REQUIRED: A published artwork needs a main image.
errors.MAIN_EXISTS: There is already a main image.
errors.NOT_A_DRAFT: Only artworks that were never published can be deleted.
errors.HAS_ORDERS: The artwork has orders or sales, so it cannot be deleted.
